maya_cs: Heads-up — Scout preview seat allocation: they signed the addendum but need first enablement Wed 3/25 @ 10am PT. Who can lead? We also need to confirm SSO test users and renewal risk note for acct team. Link: https://redwood.app/onboarding/scout-preview :eyes:
liam_se: I can run the enablement and record it. prefer 10am. I'll send calendar invite. Can we get the SSO test creds by EOD Tue?
avery_pm: Client reported SAML mismatch earlier — Nora has a patch in staging. If patch lands, SSO should be green. Also they asked for a usage dashboard walkthrough.
nora_eng: Patch deployed to staging, still failing one attribute mapping. quick fix is to set email->NameID mapping to 'email'. Testing now.
maya_cs: Thanks. Liam — if SSO isn't ready we do a temporary flows walkthrough (no auth) + invite them to re-run once live. Also capture feedback on prompt templates.
liam_se: Fine. I'll prep a short 'no-sso' demo deck. Also will capture feedback in the beta survey form: https://redwood.app/forms/beta-feedback (I added a "renewal concern" checkbox)
ops-bot: Reminder: send post-session survey 24h after enablement. Scheduled for 1769990360.
maya_cs: Perfect — @avery_pm please flag renewal owner for Scout (acct: Connor) to follow up week after enablement. I'll mark this cohort as 'high-touch' in the tracker. :white_check_mark:
avery_pm: Done. Connor notified. Any blockers after SSO fix, ping me and I'll escalate.
